title: DataRequirementsSpec
description: Phase 23 / Stage 0 output of the Strategy Research Agent (Duty 1). Enumerates the full scope of data a trade objective implies, ranked by significance, for the deterministic gap-check vs the DB inventory and the human acquire/proceed gate. Read-only research produces this; it NEVER triggers a data download.

objective_id.description: ID of the Trade Objective this scope was derived for (top of the provenance chain).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the spec was produced.

git_sha.description: Short git SHA of the codebase state at generation time.

traits.description: Objective traits used to key this spec for warm-start reuse on similar future objectives.

strategy_type.description: e.g. momentum, mean_reversion, scalping, swing, long_short, risk_neutral.

data_classes.description: The enumerated data classes the strategy implies, each ranked and justified.

name.description: Human-readable name, e.g. 'NQ L1/L2 order book'.

significance.description: Priority of this data class for the objective.

required.description: true = the model run is invalid without it; false = nice-to-have. Drives the acquire-vs-proceed decision.

rationale.description: Why this data matters — must cite an anchor (research_cases id, scored publication id, or tool result).

source_refs.description: IDs into the Scored Research Library that justify this data class (esp. novel data/feature ideas).

research_library_ref.description: Path/URI of the companion Scored Research Library artifact (research_library.schema.json) produced in the same run.
